about: Tonbo Imaging India Limited is a Bengaluru-based defence electronics original equipment manufacturer that designs and manufactures advanced electro-optics, thermal imaging, and autonomous targeting solutions. Operating an asset-light model with full in-house intellectual property ownership, the company has deployed over 28,000 systems across 24 countries worldwide.

peers.name: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited

objects.purpose: Offer for Sale by Selling Shareholders and listing benefits

promoters.background: The Promoters have worked together for over 21 years across global defence programs, led by Arvind Kondangi Lakshmikumar (MD & CEO), Ankit Kumar (optics & computer vision), and Cecilia D'Souza (finance & operations).

concentration.note: Indian Government accounted for 71.19% and foreign governments 3.34% of FY26 revenue; top ten suppliers accounted for 68.77% of FY26 total expenses.

litigation_note: Bank guarantees outstanding of ₹78.93 crore and contingent liability of ₹0.58 crore disputed under Goods and Services Tax Act pending before the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir.
strengths: Leading defence technology OEM with 100% proprietary intellectual property ownership across optics, embedded software, and electronics.
Capital-efficient asset-light model focusing on in-house R&D while outsourcing manufacturing to certified EMS partners.
Largest Indian manufacturer and exporter of thermal imaging systems, capturing 94% of India's thermal imaging export units.
Diversified portfolio of ITAR-free electro-optical systems deployed in over 24 countries across 28,000 installations.
Comprehensive product range spanning tactical weapon sights, platform systems, missile seekers, and autonomous battlefield fire control.
Robust in-house R&D infrastructure with 130 dedicated engineers comprising approximately 38% of the total workforce.

risks.title: Persistent negative operating cash flows
risks.detail: Reported negative cash flows from operations of ₹63.22 crore in FY26, ₹136.12 crore in FY25, and ₹14.68 crore in Q1 FY27.

risks.title: Lengthening working capital cycle
risks.detail: Working capital days increased substantially from 152 days in FY24 to 280 days in FY25 and 517 days in FY26.

risks.title: High supplier concentration
risks.detail: Top ten suppliers accounted for 68.77% of total expenses in FY26 and 164.00% in Q1 FY27, without long-term supply contracts.

risks.title: Heavy reliance on tactical systems revenue
risks.detail: Tactical systems contributed 58.37%, 77.24%, and 83.90% of revenue from operations in FY26, FY25, and FY24, respectively.

risks.title: Sharp decline in export revenues
risks.detail: Export share dropped sharply from 65.52% of revenue in FY25 to 5.57% in FY26 due to changes in international procurement.

risks.title: Cyclical government tender-based procurement
risks.detail: Business is highly dependent on governmental budgetary allocations and extended, multi-tiered tender cycles resulting in volatile revenue.

risks.title: Dependence on contract manufacturers
risks.detail: Relies entirely on non-exclusive contract manufacturers such as Kaynes and Avalon for commercial-scale product assembly.

risks.title: Bank guarantee exposure and tax disputes
risks.detail: Outstanding performance bank guarantees of ₹78.93 crore and contingent liabilities of ₹0.58 crore in disputed GST dues.

notes: FY24 financials are standalone as subsidiaries were incorporated in FY25; FY25 and FY26 are consolidated. Q1 FY27 stub period (ended June 30, 2026) is excluded from financial arrays.
